Welcome to BoutenkoFilms! My name is Sergei. I'm and author/filmmaker. I’m also a super curious person with a lot of different interests. Here you can expect to learn a little about a lot of different topics. Things like: wild edibles green smoothies, healthy recipes, fitness, kettlebells, vans, foraging and whatever else grabs my attention and creativity. 🎥

I recently narrowed my focus and pivoted my camera back to nature-based topics like foraging, gardening and homesteading. Moving forward, I'll be producing heap more content along these lines. 🌱 🌱 🌱

Disclosure Note: I’m required by the FTC to disclose that I'm a part of several different affiliate programs, such as Amazon Affiliates, Litra, KONG, and a few others. This means I make a little bit of $ when you click on some of the links in my video descriptions. Clicking on said links costs you nothing (in fact it often saves you $$$) and the extra revenue helps me finance new videos.💰
